header.purpose: A traceable requirement -> implemented profile -> source/model entry point -> executed test stage -> proof/evidence -> remaining-boundary matrix for revision 0.3 as implemented at this checkpoint.
header.counts_are_run_metadata: Every count in this file is run metadata about executed gates, manifests and archived measurements. A count is NOT proof of specification coverage: passing test totals, CT mapping counts, contract module counts and audit unit totals say what was executed, not what was proved. Projection coverage is not safety coverage and unknowns stay in the denominator.
header.verdict_vocabulary: Safe only after all obligations discharge; Unsafe only for a validated reachable violation; everything else Unknown. A provisional Unsafe is never presented as an upstream defect. Raw Cycle 19 units remain unpromoted.
header.independence_rule: The four evidence classes are marked INDEPENDENTLY per requirement. Support in one class is never inferred from another: a proved Lean theorem is not source evidence, an executed native run is not a model proof, and a model regression is not an observation.

evidence_classes.source: evidence taken on real source - QCore source programs through the frontend/driver, or C translation units through the gateway importers
